name: open air
description: An area of open air in what appears to be a shaft extending into the depths of the earth.  You cannot understand how or why someone would build an elevator shaft going into the depths of the earth like this for reasons other than mining.  It's bottom, if there is one, seems to be far past where light penetrates.

names: Climb down by lowering yourself from the ledge.
Can't jump across (need a small gap).
effect.title: There is a ledge here.  What do you want to do?
descriptions: You look down as far as you can see.
You hang off the ledge to get closer to a bottom you cannot see.
